blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-30. Sole catalogued deployment is the immutable Ethereum MetaMorpho vault 0xbeef…f5bc. At Ethereum block 25648449: EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots are zero (non-proxy direct code); asset()=USDC 0xa0b8…eb48; owner()=Steakhouse Safe 0x0a0e…f8dd; no pause/paused/isBlacklisted/blacklist/freeze/burn(account) selectors in bytecode. Official MetaMorpho.sol is ERC4626 + ERC20Permit + Ownable2Step with no holder deny-list, pause, or seizure path — owner curation/fees do not gate share transfer. Local transfer posture is therefore permissionless. Holder freeze exposure is inherited from the USDC reserve asset (Circle blacklist on the underlying), via variantOf/mintAuthority.inheritedFrom usdc-circle, not from a vault-level control. Transfer categorical publication still requires chainCirculatingById for material deployment scope.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: bbqUSDC is tracked as one Ethereum MetaMorpho vault token. The reviewed Steakhouse and Morpho source set does not show a durable bridge route for this vault share.
